game_start.intro: Piya pɩɣa. Pɩlaɣa tɛɛ tʊmɩyɛ: {trump_suit} (pɩlaɣa tɛɛ kaɣɖɛ: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Nyɛ kɩlaɣ {player_id} kɛ German Whist taa.
{phase_info}
Nyɛ wɛna kɔɔka {hand_size}.
Pɛlɛ kɔɔka na '[play N]', ɛntɛ N yɛ kɔɔka ŋga nɛ wɛna a-tɩm kɛ a-lɩm taa (kpɛlɛkɛ '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: KƖYAKƲ YƆ: Paa kpɩtaʋ ŋgʋ lɛ, weyi ɛwabɩnɩ-kʋ yɔ, ɛmʋʋ kɩlɛmɩŋ yɔɔ kɛdɛsɩ nɛ weyi eleba yɔ, ɛkpaɣ pʋwayɩ.
player_prompt.phase_playing: Kpaɣnɩ sɔnɔ lɛ, paa aleɣya wena ŋlakɩ yɔ a-tɩŋa akɔŋ sɩnʋʋ nɛ ɖɩwa.

next_card.playing_phase: Pahaɣ ɛyaa takayaɣ nakɛyɛ, mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ aleɣya paɣzɩ.
next_card.deck_empty: Kaɖaɣ fɛyɩ - paapɩzɩɣ nɛ pakpaɣ ka-taa nakɛyɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pɩfɛyɩ ɖeu se ŋɖɔmna nɛ pɩɖɛɛ. Labɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ "[play N]" pʋcɔ nɛ ŋkpaɣ ña-n̄ʋʋ nɩŋgbaŋaɣ ŋga kɛwɛ ñe-nesi tɛɛ yɔ.
invalid_move.bad_position: Kaarɩtɩ lone nɖɩ ɖɩfɛyɩ. Ŋwɛna {hand_size} kaartaŋ.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Pɩwɛɛ se ŋɖɔ ɛ-nʋmɔʋ taa nɛ ŋkpaɣ {lead_suit} takayaɣ.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Pɩfɛyɩ se ɖɩlabɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ takayaɣ ŋga.

game_action.played: Ɛyʊ {player_id} ɛlakaɣ tʊma ndɩ ndɩ nɛ payaa-ɩ se {card}.

trick.won_learning: Pɩlaɣa {winner_id} wɛɛ tʊmɩyɛ ŋga {card} ɛlɛ pɩlaɣa tɛɛ kaɣɖɛ.

phase.learning_complete: Pɩtɛ lɛ, ɖɩpaɣzɩ kpɛlɩkʋʋ nɛ paa aleɣya wena a-taa ɖihikiɣ ñɩm yɔ, awɛ kɩjɛyʋʋ se ɖɩla.

draw.loser_received: Ŋlesi aleɣya nɛ ŋlɩzɩ {card} kɛ kpata taa.

turn.scores_learning: Tɔm kɛdɩtʊ ɖɩwɩɣ so far - Pɩyalɩ 0: {tricks0}, Pɩyalɩ 1: {tricks1}
turn.phase_learning: Tʊmɩyɛ taa: {phase} ({remaining_cards} kaɣɖɛ pɩlaɣa tɛɛ tʊmɩyɛ taa)

board_str.current_trick: {observation} Lɩmaɣza wena ɛyaa wɛnɩ sɔnɔ yɔ:
board_str.player_line:
{observation}
Pɩlaɣa {player_id}: {scoring} tʊmɩyɛ taa ({tricks} tʊmɩyɛ), {hand_size} kaɣɖɛ pɩlaɣa tɛɛ tʊmɩyɛ taa

outcome.summary: Sɔnzɩ tʊmɩyɛ taa - Pɩlaɣa 0: {l0}, Pɩlaɣa 1: {l1}. Pɩlaɣa tɛɛ tʊmɩyɛ taa - Pɩlaɣa 0: {p0}, Pɩlaɣa 1: {p1}. Pɩlaɣa {winner_id} wɛɛ tʊmɩyɛ ŋga {winner_tricks} tʊmɩyɛ taa!
